intent: Remove the subagent unreported label: a normal turn without a report displays as done in the Dock, notification box and /agents, failed and interrupted turns keep only their state, and the main agent is told the turn has no task status instead of a fake done report.

findings.summary: 2 idle turn kinds that did not end normally show a green done: a final reply cut at the token limit (stopReason length) and a turn with no message. finishTurn separates only abort and error. Both reviewers reproduced it with a faux session: state=idle, displayed=done. reference.md promises done only for a normal end.

The case comment claims a restored unfinished turn after an idle one, but the fixture's last turn is itself interrupted. Passing lastTurn.state at inspector.ts:327 and :366 keeps all 599 tests green while a real unfinished run then reads `interrupted · done`, so the inspector's run.state source is untested.

Still present on Core Theme only: activityStatus(idle) gives a cut-short turn status done, so the row and card header keep the green done mark with no state word. Real ActivityCard render: same mark as a finished run, and style.ts says done is implied by its mark. CHANGELOG and reference.md promise only its state; notification-box.test.ts pins done. Dock, plain box and inspector are fixed.
findings.resolution: The card's detail names idle for a cut-short turn (activityDetailStatus).

findings.summary: 2 faux runs: Pi drops a length reply below maxTokens before settling, so this reads the older reply. Text+tool call, result, length reply: idle, cutShort unset, done, older text sent as last message. Follow-up turn whose only reply is dropped: done, previous turn's answer forwarded, no diagnostics. Tests avoid it by setting maxTokens to 1.
findings.resolution: finishTurn reads the turn's last reply captured at message_end when it stopped at length.

findings.summary: New instance; the round 1 fixture is fixed. This case claims the list row shows only the state, but its regex also matches `● reviewer idle done`. Mutation passing undefined for cutShort at inspector.ts:327 keeps all 609 tests green (npm test in a private copy), so the list row's cut-short behaviour is untested.
findings.resolution: The list row regex now ends at the cell border; dropping cutShort at inspector.ts:327 alone fails the test.

findings.summary: Old stored turn records have no cutShort, so a turn saved with unreportedMessage "" shows done after restore, though reference.md says a turn that left no text shows no status. Read from code: parseTurnRecord casts; the field existed at c766aa1; displayedStatus(idle, undefined, undefined) returns done. The older-details test covers only non-empty text. Not run.
findings.resolution: Stored data has none of these (114 run files, 141 turns, 13 without a report), the package is unreleased, and records cut at the limit before this change cannot be recovered anyway.

findings.summary: Still present for a length reply below the model limit: Pi removes it from session.messages (context_edit) and, if compaction declines or fails, never retries, so `last` is an older message and the text is non-empty. Probe, faux stopReason length, maxTokens 16384, short session: state=idle, cutShort unset, displayed=done. Contradicts reference.md:189 and CHANGELOG.md:40.
findings.resolution: Same defect as F2-2, fixed by the same change.

findings.summary: Turn 1 ends in a model error; the follow-up's only reply is a dropped length reply. State still reads the session's last assistant message, so turn 2 is failed with the old error and no cutShort. Probe: state=failed, error='boom from turn one', msg='Second turn cut off'. Same state and error at c28ff372 and c766aa1, so old; turn.lastReply could now fix it.
findings.resolution: Fixed in 2e3f24c: finishTurn reads state and error from the active turn lastReply. Covered by reports.test.ts: a follow-up turn with a dropped length reply after a failed turn is cut short without the earlier error.

findings.summary: 2 instances remain: finishTurn trusts session.messages for replies Pi drops; cut covers only length. Overflow error in a follow-up, compaction summary fails: idle, no error, displayed=done, older `First turn text.` forwarded. Failed turn (`boom`), then dropped length reply: failed, stale boom (line 603, untouched). Probe: node --experimental-strip-types --test test/integration/rev3-probe.test.ts
findings.resolution: Fixed in 2e3f24c: finishTurn uses the current turn reply even after Pi removes it for recovery. reports.test.ts covers overflow after a tool round, overflow in a follow-up, failed compaction summary, and a dropped length reply after a failed turn.

abandonedReason: The three-round review exposed session history as the wrong source for turn outcomes. Commit 2e3f24c changes the source to the active turn reply; the completed fixes and regression coverage will be reviewed under fix-subagent-turn-outcome. Keep this ledger as evidence.
